bundle.shortDescription: 9-zip - archive manager with the self-healing .9z format
bundle.longDescription: 9-zip is a free archive manager for Windows. It creates 10 formats (9Z, 7Z, ZIP, TAR, GZIP, BZIP2, XZ, ZSTD, LZ4 and BROTLI), including the self-healing .9z format with built-in Reed-Solomon recovery data.
